name: Princess "Tiara" Cucumber & Lemon-Herb Cream Cheese Sandwiches

instructions.primary_message: TO MAKE THE LEMON-HERB CREAM CHEESE: Cut cream cheese into small pieces, place in a medium bowl, and set aside to soften.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lemon
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 small pkg chives

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemon into the bowl with the cream cheese.
Shave parsley and dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add herbs to the bowl.
Chop chives into small pieces. Add to the bowl along with spices, then use a hand-held mixer or the back of a spoon to combine the cream cheese spread. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim, peel, and slice cucumbers crosswise into thin rounds. Place on a plate.

Arrange bread slices on a flat surface and spread each with lemon-herb cream cheese. Top half of the bread slices with cucumber, then close with the remaining slices, pressing gently to 'stick' the sandwiches together.
instructions.secondary_message:
16 slice white bread
16 slice whole grain bread

instructions.primary_message: Trim crusts from each sandwich, then cut a "v" pattern into the top, creating a "tiara." (Don't waste these cut-outs, they are great for snacking!)
Arrange sandwiches on a platter and enjoy!
